headline.purpose: Primary sign-in screen heading (24px on sm+ viewports, 20px on narrow screens).

title.purpose: Workspace page headings (20px) and structural security/error panel titles (16px).

body.purpose: Primary operational copy, form inputs, field labels, navigation labels, and standard table cells.

shadows.name: drawer-mobile
shadows.purpose: Transient elevation applied solely to the slide-over mobile navigation drawer below 1024px; desktop surfaces remain flat at rest.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Sumatra teal-jade primary submit action with 44px touch height and crisp focus ring.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 16px; border: none; border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 4px); background-color: var(--accent-primary, #0e5a53); color: var(--accent-primary-ink, #ffffff); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4286; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: var(--accent-primary-hover, #0a4640); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-primary, #0e5a53); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Flat white outline action button with strong neutral stroke for header sign-out and fallback navigation.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #b2b8ae); border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 4px); background-color: var(--bg-surface, #ffffff); color: var(--text-primary, #171c1e); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3333; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background-color: var(--bg-chrome, #eef0eb); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-primary, #0e5a53); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4286; color: var(--text-primary, #171c1e); } .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #b2b8ae); border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 4px); background-color: var(--bg-surface, #ffffff); color: var(--text-primary, #171c1e); caret-color: var(--accent-primary, #0e5a53); font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.4286; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-muted, #5d676b); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-primary, #0e5a53); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: var(--status-danger-text, #941b20); }

components.css: .ds-record-card { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--border-hairline, #d5d9d2); border-radius: var(--radius-md, 6px); background-color: var(--bg-surface, #ffffff); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-record-header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-hairline, #d5d9d2); background-color: var(--bg-subtle, #f1f3ee); color: var(--text-primary, #171c1e); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3333; } .ds-record-header svg { color: var(--accent-primary, #0e5a53); flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-record-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; text-align: left; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.4286; } .ds-record-row { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-hairline, #d5d9d2); } .ds-record-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; } .ds-record-th { width: 240px; padding: 12px 16px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-secondary, #495256); } .ds-record-td { padding: 12px 16px; color: var(--text-primary, #171c1e); } .ds-code-tabular { font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 13px; }

components.css: .ds-nav-rail { width: 232px; padding: 14px; border-right: 1px solid var(--border-hairline, #d5d9d2); background-color: var(--bg-chrome, #eef0eb); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-title { margin: 0; padding: 0 8px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3333; color: var(--text-secondary, #495256); } .ds-nav-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; margin-top: 8px; } .ds-nav-active, .ds-nav-locked { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; width: 100%; min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 10px; border: none; border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 4px); font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.4286; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-active { background-color: var(--accent-primary, #0e5a53); color: var(--accent-primary-ink, #ffffff); font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-primary, #0e5a53); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-locked { background-color: transparent; color: var(--text-muted, #5d676b); text-align: left; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-nav-label { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; } .ds-nav-lock-icon { opacity: 0.75; flex-shrink: 0; }

narrative.overview:
Orphac Athera treats enterprise operations like a calm, verifiable Indonesian commercial ledger and dispatch book rather than a promotional SaaS dashboard. Every screen pairs a warm archival paper canvas with crisp white operational sheets, cool slate navigation chrome, and tight 1px hairline structural rules so procurement, warehouse, and finance staff can audit identity, scope, and record tables without visual noise.

Visual hierarchy relies on tonal paper stepping, explicit document status copy, and tabular numeric alignment rather than ornamental cards or elevated shadows. Sumatra teal-jade acts exclusively as a functional signal for primary submissions, active navigation items, the bilingual locale switch, and keyboard focus rings, leaving business warnings and errors in dedicated high-contrast semantic registers.

Confirmed visual rejections include gradient metric hero tiles, decorative avatars, unanchored modals, color-only status indicators, and uppercase eyebrow kickers above section titles.
keyCharacteristics: Warm archival paper ground (#f6f5f0) stepped against cool slate chrome (#eef0eb) and crisp white work sheets (#ffffff).
Flat surfaces separated strictly by 1px structural hairlines (#d5d9d2) and stronger control strokes (#b2b8ae).
Action-only Sumatra teal-jade (#0e5a53) isolated from semantic warning (#7b4900) and danger (#941b20) states.
Bilingual Indonesian (id-ID default) and English (en-US) operational copy with .font-code monospace and tabular-nums reserved for identifiers and WIB timestamps.
Direct, unadorned headings with 1.75px-stroke vector icons (lucide-react) and explicit fail-closed boundary indicators.

rules.name: The Action-Only Accent Rule
rules.body: Sumatra Teal-Jade (#0e5a53) is restricted to interactive primary controls, active navigation state, the brand shield mark, inline anchor icons, and keyboard focus rings; never flood cards, banners, or decorative tiles with teal background fills.

rules.name: The Distinct Semantic Signal Rule
rules.body: Semantic status tokens (status-ok, status-warn, status-danger) stay strictly separate from brand teal and never rely on color alone—every badge, banner, or callout pairs tinted fill and 1px matching border with an icon and explicit state text.

rules.name: The Tabular Ledger Rule
rules.body: Machine identifiers, emails, status codes, WIB timestamps, and numeric ledger entries pair .font-code monospace with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so columns and key-value sheets align down the vertical scanline.

rules.name: The Direct Heading Rule
rules.body: Page and section headings enter directly in semibold (600) with -0.025em tracking without uppercase eyebrow kickers above them.

rules.name: The Single-Rail Workspace Rule
rules.body: Primary navigation occupies one 232px left rail on desktop (collapsing into an on-demand slide-over drawer below 1024px)—never secondary inner sidebars or competing horizontal nav bars.

rules.name: The Hairline Paper Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest and separated by tonal paper steps and 1px structural hairlines (#d5d9d2), reserving drop shadows strictly for transient mobile drawer overlays.

dos: Do preserve the four-tier paper surface ladder (#f6f5f0 canvas, #eef0eb navigation chrome, #ffffff operational sheet, #f1f3ee table header strips) separated by 1px solid #d5d9d2 hairlines.
Do format machine identifiers, emails, status codes, WIB timestamps, and currency/quantity cells with .font-code and tabular-nums (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) so rows align down scanlines.
Do pair every semantic status (status-warn, status-danger, status-ok) with an explicit 1.75px-stroke lucide-react icon, 1px matching border, and clear bilingual copy rather than color alone.
Do maintain 36px–44px minimum interactive heights and preserve the global 2px solid #0e5a53 focus-visible outline (2px offset) across every link, input, and button.
Do disable smooth scrolling and pulse animations under @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce).
donts: Don't add drop shadows to desktop cards, record tables, inputs, or buttons; shadows belong strictly on transient mobile drawer overlays below 1024px.

Don't apply Sumatra Teal-Jade (#0e5a53) to decorative metric banners, background gradients, or warning states; reserve it strictly for actions, active navigation, brand shield, inline anchor icons, and focus rings.
Don't place uppercase eyebrow kickers above headings or fabricate placeholder KPI dashboard tiles before real ledger data exists.
Don't ship vague failure messages ("Something went wrong"); display concrete server/boundary states and next legal actions via role="alert" and aria-describedby.
Don't substitute unicode/emoji glyphs for 1.75px-stroke lucide-react vector icons (aria-hidden="true").
